infotexts.JobDescription.assistant_arcane: An assistant who learns, copies, and shares magical knowledge.
infotexts.JobDescription.assistant_mystic: An assistant who channels possessed spirits at a price.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Assistant_Arcan: Hold in both hands and use or aim. Requires Assistant, both primary talent stages completed, and 60 base Magic. Consumed to register a transition, applied next round or to a newly spawned body after death. Lose 40% total experience; clear the old job tree and its permanent records. Keep external talents, skills, and equipment.
infotexts.entitydescription.Touhou_Assistant_Mysti: Hold in both hands and use or aim. Requires Assistant, both primary talent stages completed, and 60 base Weapons. Consumed to register a transition, applied next round or to a newly spawned body after death. Lose 40% total experience; clear the old job tree and its permanent records. Keep external talents, skills, and equipment.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_ScribeAssistant: +10 Magic and +5% danmaku damage. The flat bonus does not alter base skill or accumulate through respecs.
+20% Reiki Disorder resistance. Allows skills to reach 120.
+10% effective skill levels. Allows skills to reach 120.
When you complete any mission in a round, gain a Magic Tutorial and a 30% chance of an additional Spell Book.
All crew, including yourself, gain +10% mission experience. You gain +10% maximum health.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_SpiritAssistant: +10% maximum health while possessed; an additional +10% while also fully possessed.

While possessed, gain the corresponding Costume+ character effects and associated talent, including drawbacks. Does not replace equipped clothes or grant their physical armor, containers, scanners, or item-use buttons. The same costume talent is not granted twice.
+10% danmaku damage below 130 maximum health; otherwise gain 10% physical damage resistance. Checks maximum health, not remaining health.
Each +1% maximum-health stat bonus grants +0.5% all attack damage, capped at +10%.
infotexts.talentdescription.Touhou_Special_Assista: +10% maximum health. Each +1% generic movement-speed stat bonus grants +0.5% attack damage, capped at +15%. Does not use instantaneous velocity. Negative bonuses do not reduce damage.
